trials.name: Strict sampled trajectory rescue to nominal deployment
trials.motivation: Current history bank accepts only strict-good nominal B1 witnesses. Sampled G16 good trajectories from a nominal-bad scene are not admitted as those history teachers.
trials.eligible: TRAIN-only same-version G16 strict NC=DAC=TTC=Comfort=1; canonical>=.9; nominal B1 not strict-good; candidate score minus nominal score>=.02
trials.method: Separate supervised self-imitation / flow-matching target for one strict-good sampled trajectory; never relabel historical rollouts as fresh PPO.
trials.budget: Within fixed beta50 anchor budget: IL share=1-.25*history_gate-.05*rescue_gate; coefficients are not gradient fractions.
trials.evidence_status: Adaptation hypothesis; no score claim; implementation and independent recipe required before dispatch

trials.name: Small always-on history floor with gated increment
trials.motivation: Only23 of5952 selected historical slots activate current25% conditional budget through625; effective global coefficient is much smaller than25%.
trials.change: When a valid prior-window historical teacher exists, alpha_history=.05+.20*regression_gate; otherwise0. Keep beta50 fixed and IL coefficient=1-alpha_history.
trials.control: Change only history weight rule; same B64/G16/scoring/schedule and fresh IL70.
trials.risk: Can preserve a suboptimal older nominal policy; candidate improvements and deployed high-cohort preservation must both be measured.
trials.alternative: Risk-prioritized historical selection within the same existing B1 query budget; separate ablation rather than silently combining both.
trials.evidence_status: Low early gate rate is observed, not proof current long-run retention is ineffective
